profile.name: 多轴电动位移台
profile.description: 一种带电机驱动的多轴精密位移装置，可进行绝对/相对移动、回零、设定原点和单位切换，常用于显微镜物镜或样品的精密定位、扫描和对准。
profile.description_en: A motor-driven multi-axis precision translation device that supports absolute/relative motion, homing, defining a home position, and unit selection. It is commonly used for precise positioning, scanning, and alignment of microscope objectives or samples.
